title: Min Chinese - Wikipedia
text: The most widely spoken variety of Min outside of China is Hokkien, a variety of Southern Min that has its origin in Southern Fujian. Amoy Hokkien is the prestige dialect of Hokkien in Fujian, while a majority of Taiwanese people speak a dialect called Taiwanese Hokkien or simply Taiwanese.
